# Sri Maniya Institute of Hotel Management

> Sri Maniya Institute provides hotel management courses in Tamil Nadu, India, with practical training, placement support, and career-focused hospitality education.

Sri Maniya Institute offers diploma and certificate programs in hotel management and hospitality, backed by industry placements, scholarships for eligible students, and campus facilities designed for hands-on training.

## Site

- [Home](https://srimaniyainstitute.in/): Overview of the institute, programs, and highlights.
- [About Us](https://srimaniyainstitute.in/about-us): History, mission, and facilities of Sri Maniya Institute.
- [Courses](https://srimaniyainstitute.in/courses): Hotel management and hospitality courses offered, with online application.
- [Placements](https://srimaniyainstitute.in/placements): Placement support and hiring partners for graduates.
- [Careers](https://srimaniyainstitute.in/career): Hospitality career opportunities in India and abroad, and current job openings.
- [Scholarship](https://srimaniyainstitute.in/scholarship): Hotel management scholarship program in Tamil Nadu.
- [Events & Blog](https://srimaniyainstitute.in/events-blog): News, events, and updates from the institute.
- [Registration Form](https://srimaniyainstitute.in/registration-form): Online admission/registration form for courses.
- [Contact Us](https://srimaniyainstitute.in/contact-us): Campus location, phone, and enquiry details.
